sourceTitle: Anthropic 推出 Frontier Academy：围绕真实业务项目培养 AI 工程人才
originalTitle: Anthropic invests $100 million to train 10,000 engineers and tackle the enterprise AI talent gap
author: Anthropic

blocks.text: Today we are launching Claude Frontier Academy to solve one of the most pressing issues in AI implementation: talent. Backed by a $100 million commitment, Anthropic aims to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers (FDEs) by the end of 2027. Engineers from Accenture, Bain, Capgemini, Commonwealth Bank of Australia, Deloitte, McKinsey, Morgan Stanley and Novo Nordisk are in the first cohorts.
blocks.zh: 今天，我们推出 Claude Frontier Academy，以解决 AI 落地中最紧迫的问题之一：人才。Anthropic 承诺投入 1 亿美元，目标是在 2027 年底前培养 10,000 名 Frontier Deployed Engineers（FDE，前沿部署工程师）。首批学员包括来自埃森哲、贝恩、凯捷、澳大利亚联邦银行、德勤、麦肯锡、摩根士丹利和诺和诺德的工程师。
blocks.en: Today we are launching Claude Frontier Academy to solve one of the most pressing issues in AI implementation: talent. Backed by a $100 million commitment, Anthropic aims to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers (FDEs) by the end of 2027. Engineers from Accenture, Bain, Capgemini, Commonwealth Bank of Australia, Deloitte, McKinsey, Morgan Stanley and Novo Nordisk are in the first cohorts.

blocks.text: Every enterprise is racing to bring AI into its organization, but the people with the skills to make it work inside a real business have become the hardest talent to find. Inside the companies we work with, a small group of deeply skilled people drives an outsized share of what AI delivers. The Academy is the first of its kind from an AI company, built from our own work deploying Claude inside the world’s largest enterprises and the professional services organizations that serve them.
blocks.zh: 每个企业都在争先恐后地将AI带入组织,但那些有能力在真正的企业中工作的人 成了最难找到的人才在我们合作的公司里少数高技能人才在AI提供的产品中占据了相当大的比例。学院是AI公司的第一家这类公司,将Claude部署在世界上最大的企业和服务于他们的专业服务组织中。
blocks.en: Every enterprise is racing to bring AI into its organization, but the people with the skills to make it work inside a real business have become the hardest talent to find. Inside the companies we work with, a small group of deeply skilled people drives an outsized share of what AI delivers. The Academy is the first of its kind from an AI company, built from our own work deploying Claude inside the world’s largest enterprises and the professional services organizations that serve them.

blocks.text: “A small team of high-agency people with the right skills, access to Claude, and a deep understanding of how their business runs can transform an entire company. The hard part is building that depth of talent, engineers with the highest level of AI fluency who can take Claude from an idea to a system in production and turn it into faster processes and new products and services. No AI company has invested in developing that talent inside its customers and partners at this depth. Claude Frontier Academy trains people the way our own engineers learn, and we want those who graduate to set the standard for how AI gets built inside a business.” – Steve Corfield, Global Head of Business Development and Partnerships at Anthropic
blocks.zh: “一个由高度主动的人组成的小团队，只要具备合适的技能、能够使用 Claude，并深入理解自身业务如何运作，就可以改变整家公司。难点在于培养具有这种深度的人才：他们是 AI 应用熟练度最高的工程师，能够把 Claude 从一个想法变成实际投产的系统，进而带来更快的流程以及新的产品和服务。此前还没有 AI 公司如此深入地投入资源，在客户和合作伙伴内部培养这类人才。Claude Frontier Academy 采用我们自身工程师的学习方式来培养人才；我们希望毕业学员能为企业内部如何构建 AI 树立标准。”——Steve Corfield，Anthropic 全球业务发展与合作伙伴关系负责人
blocks.en: “A small team of high-agency people with the right skills, access to Claude, and a deep understanding of how their business runs can transform an entire company. The hard part is building that depth of talent, engineers with the highest level of AI fluency who can take Claude from an idea to a system in production and turn it into faster processes and new products and services. No AI company has invested in developing that talent inside its customers and partners at this depth. Claude Frontier Academy trains people the way our own engineers learn, and we want those who graduate to set the standard for how AI gets built inside a business.” – Steve Corfield, Global Head of Business Development and Partnerships at Anthropic

blocks.text: The first program trains 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers
blocks.zh: 第一个计划是培训10 000名边疆部署工程师
blocks.en: The first program trains 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers

blocks.text: The Academy’s first program, the Frontier Deployed Engineer Residency, follows the medical model for building expertise. Doctors learn from practicing physicians, train on real cases, and are assessed before they practice alone. Likewise, FDE Residency engineers learn from practitioners, practice on realistic cases, and are assessed on their work before they earn the credential. The goal is agentic systems that change how a business runs, from faster, redesigned processes to new products and services.
blocks.zh: 学院的第一个课程,边疆部署的工程师居住区,遵循医疗模式建立专门知识。医生从执业医生那里学到,进行关于真实案例的培训,在他们单独练习之前,他们要接受评估。同样,FDE 居住工程师向从业人员学习,实际案例的实践,在他们获得证书之前,要对他们的工作进行评估。目标是改变企业经营方式的代理系统,从快到快重新设计了新产品和服务的流程。
blocks.en: The Academy’s first program, the Frontier Deployed Engineer Residency, follows the medical model for building expertise. Doctors learn from practicing physicians, train on real cases, and are assessed before they practice alone. Likewise, FDE Residency engineers learn from practitioners, practice on realistic cases, and are assessed on their work before they earn the credential. The goal is agentic systems that change how a business runs, from faster, redesigned processes to new products and services.

blocks.text: The program is for hands-on software engineers with strong fundamentals, a record of building with LLMs, experience helping others adopt AI, and a habit of tackling their business’s most important problems. Organizations nominate their strongest engineers, each arriving with a named Claude project to lead when they return. Prior experience building AI agents isn’t required.
blocks.zh: 这个程序是针对具有强大基础的操作软件工程师的,与LLMS一起建造的记录,帮助他人接受AI的经验;并习惯于处理企业最重要的问题。各组织提名最强的工程师,每个人带着一个叫Claude的项目到达 他们回来后会领头不需要事先积累人工智能人员的经验。
blocks.en: The program is for hands-on software engineers with strong fundamentals, a record of building with LLMs, experience helping others adopt AI, and a habit of tackling their business’s most important problems. Organizations nominate their strongest engineers, each arriving with a named Claude project to lead when they return. Prior experience building AI agents isn’t required.

blocks.text: Engineers start with a multi-day in-person program with Anthropic engineers and licensed instructors. They work through a simulated enterprise deployment, from the right use case through security review to handover, and finish with a graded practical on a new scenario. Those who pass earn the Claude Resident Engineer badge and move into the 12-week residency, where they lead a real Claude use case at their own organization, supported by Anthropic engineers and learning from their cohort as they build. Engineers are assessed again at the end of the 12 weeks, and those who pass earn the Claude Frontier Deployed Engineer badge, with the first expected in early 2027.
blocks.zh: 工程师们从一个多日的面对面程序开始,由Anthropic工程师和有执照的教官组成.他们通过模拟企业部署工作,从正确的使用案例到安全审查到移交,并完成一个分级 实用在新的情景。过世者获得Claude驻地工程师的徽章 进入12周的住所在那里他们领导了一个真正的Claude案件 在他们自己的组织,由Anthropic工程师支持,并在他们建设时向他们的团队学习.在12周结束时再次评估工程师,和那些获得Claude边疆 部署工程师的徽章的人,与2027年初的首个预期.
blocks.en: Engineers start with a multi-day in-person program with Anthropic engineers and licensed instructors. They work through a simulated enterprise deployment, from the right use case through security review to handover, and finish with a graded practical on a new scenario. Those who pass earn the Claude Resident Engineer badge and move into the 12-week residency, where they lead a real Claude use case at their own organization, supported by Anthropic engineers and learning from their cohort as they build. Engineers are assessed again at the end of the 12 weeks, and those who pass earn the Claude Frontier Deployed Engineer badge, with the first expected in early 2027.

blocks.text: The first cohorts are running now
blocks.zh: 第一批已经出发了
blocks.en: The first cohorts are running now

blocks.text: Cohorts are running in San Francisco, New York and London. The program will grow toward 10,000 engineers by the end of 2027. Participation is by nomination; organizations can ask their Anthropic account team or Partner Account Manager whether they’re eligible.
blocks.zh: 培训班正在旧金山、纽约和伦敦开展。该项目计划到 2027 年底扩大至 10,000 名工程师。参与采用提名制；组织可以向其 Anthropic 客户团队或合作伙伴客户经理咨询是否符合资格。
blocks.en: Cohorts are running in San Francisco, New York and London. The program will grow toward 10,000 engineers by the end of 2027. Participation is by nomination; organizations can ask their Anthropic account team or Partner Account Manager whether they’re eligible.

blocks.text: Leading enterprises and consulting firms are in the first cohorts
blocks.zh: 主要企业和咨询公司属于第一批
blocks.en: Leading enterprises and consulting firms are in the first cohorts

blocks.text: “At Accenture, forward deployed engineers translate AI ambition into enterprise-wide impact, working inside client workflows as part of multidisciplinary teams that engineer AI concepts into production-ready, governed solutions built to scale. Anthropic built the residency the same way we think about the role: judgment tested against a simulated enterprise deployment, not technical skills in isolation. Joining Claude Frontier Academy will deepen our engineers’ Claude expertise and accelerate the value we deliver for our clients.”
blocks.zh: “在埃森哲，前线部署工程师将 AI 愿景转化为覆盖整个企业的实际成效。他们深入客户的工作流程，作为跨学科团队的一部分，将 AI 概念打造为可投入生产、具备治理机制且可规模化扩展的解决方案。Anthropic 设计驻场培训项目的方式，与我们对这一岗位的理解一致：通过模拟企业部署来检验判断力，而不是孤立地考查技术技能。加入 Claude Frontier Academy，将深化我们工程师对 Claude 的专业能力，加快我们为客户创造价值的速度。”
blocks.en: “At Accenture, forward deployed engineers translate AI ambition into enterprise-wide impact, working inside client workflows as part of multidisciplinary teams that engineer AI concepts into production-ready, governed solutions built to scale. Anthropic built the residency the same way we think about the role: judgment tested against a simulated enterprise deployment, not technical skills in isolation. Joining Claude Frontier Academy will deepen our engineers’ Claude expertise and accelerate the value we deliver for our clients.”

blocks.text: FDE and Software & Platform Engineering lead, Accenture
blocks.zh: FDE和软件与平台工程铅,摄像头
blocks.en: FDE and Software & Platform Engineering lead, Accenture

blocks.text: “Building deep, hands-on AI engineering capability is critical to helping clients move from experimentation to impact at scale. The Frontier Deployed Engineer Residency will give our engineers the opportunity to sharpen their expertise working directly with Anthropic and bring that experience to our work with clients.”
blocks.zh: “深造,人工智能工程能力对于帮助客户从实验转向规模影响至关重要。边疆部署的工程师居住区将使我们的工程师有机会加强直接与Anthropic合作的专门知识,并将这种经验带给我们的工作。与客户。”
blocks.en: “Building deep, hands-on AI engineering capability is critical to helping clients move from experimentation to impact at scale. The Frontier Deployed Engineer Residency will give our engineers the opportunity to sharpen their expertise working directly with Anthropic and bring that experience to our work with clients.”

blocks.text: Partner, Global Head of Engineering, Bain
blocks.zh: 搭档全球工程主管,贝恩
blocks.en: Partner, Global Head of Engineering, Bain

blocks.text: “What I’m hearing from clients isn’t about certification counts or training volume; it’s about knowing firsthand how to solve real-world problems that create value to our clients. By working side by side with Anthropic’s own engineers, Capgemini is investing in and building the delivery excellence that clients recognize immediately.”
blocks.zh: " 我从客户那里听到的不是认证数或培训量;如何解决给我们的客户带来价值的现实世界问题。和Anthropic自己的工程师一起工作,Capgemini正在投资并建设客户立即认识到的优秀服务。”
blocks.en: “What I’m hearing from clients isn’t about certification counts or training volume; it’s about knowing firsthand how to solve real-world problems that create value to our clients. By working side by side with Anthropic’s own engineers, Capgemini is investing in and building the delivery excellence that clients recognize immediately.”

blocks.text: Global Head of AI Partnerships Ecosystem, Capgemini
blocks.zh: AI 伙伴关系生态系统全球负责人,卡普格米尼岛( Capgemini)
blocks.en: Global Head of AI Partnerships Ecosystem, Capgemini

blocks.text: “AI is transforming the way we build, deliver and innovate for customers. Our engineers use AI tools every day, and our teams have produced up to 3x more code changes in the past year. The Frontier Deployed Engineer Residency takes them deeper, with hands-on experience building, securing and shipping alongside peers at the frontier. We are building tomorrow’s bank today, and this program gives our teams the tools and expertise to engineer the best possible products for our customers.”
blocks.zh: “大赦国际正在改变我们建设的方式,为客户提供和创新服务。我们的工程师每天都使用AI工具,我们的团队在过去一年中又做了多达3x的代码修改.边疆部署的工程师居住区让他们更深入,与实践经验建设,与同行一道在边境进行保安和航运。我们今天正在建造明天的银行,并且这个计划给我们的团队提供了工具和专门知识,以便为我们的客户设计出尽可能好的产品。”
blocks.en: “AI is transforming the way we build, deliver and innovate for customers. Our engineers use AI tools every day, and our teams have produced up to 3x more code changes in the past year. The Frontier Deployed Engineer Residency takes them deeper, with hands-on experience building, securing and shipping alongside peers at the frontier. We are building tomorrow’s bank today, and this program gives our teams the tools and expertise to engineer the best possible products for our customers.”

blocks.text: Group Chief Technology Officer, Commonwealth Bank of Australia
blocks.zh: 集团首席技术干事,澳大利亚联邦银行.
blocks.en: Group Chief Technology Officer, Commonwealth Bank of Australia

blocks.text: “AI deployment at enterprise scale requires skilled people who can drive a project from first requirements through security review to real adoption. The Claude Frontier Academy’s FDE Residency enables us to scale a discipline we’ve already tested in the field, which is why we are excited to be part of the inaugural cohort, bringing our engineers in early to extend our bench of Claude-ready talent.”
blocks.zh: “AI在企业规模的部署需要熟练人员,他们可以推动一个项目,从最初要求到安全审查,再到真正通过。Claude Frontier Academy的FDE 居住权使我们能够推广我们已经在现场测试过的学科,这就是为什么我们兴奋 成为创始组的成员,让工程师们早点到来, 来扩展我们克洛德的天赋。”
blocks.en: “AI deployment at enterprise scale requires skilled people who can drive a project from first requirements through security review to real adoption. The Claude Frontier Academy’s FDE Residency enables us to scale a discipline we’ve already tested in the field, which is why we are excited to be part of the inaugural cohort, bringing our engineers in early to extend our bench of Claude-ready talent.”

blocks.text: Principal, Deloitte Consulting LLP
blocks.zh: 校长,德勤咨询有限公司
blocks.en: Principal, Deloitte Consulting LLP

blocks.text: “This collaboration between McKinsey and Anthropic is about leveraging frontier AI to create superior business outcomes for clients. Our technologists bring frontier AI expertise, sector depth and a value-creation mindset to our client work. The Residency sets the bar for how they apply Claude in service of our clients’ business goals, giving our world-class talent experience learning frontier techniques alongside Anthropic’s engineers. The Claude Frontier Academy and FDE Residency extend our technologists’ toolkit, helping them solve our clients’ toughest problems hands-on-keys.”
blocks.zh: “McKinsey和Anthropic之间的这一合作涉及利用前沿AI为客户创造更好的商业成果。我们的技术人员带来了前沿AI的专业知识,部门深度和我们客户工作的价值创造思维。居住区为Claude如何为客户的商业目标服务设置了障碍,与Anthropic的工程师一起学习前沿技术。Claude Frontier Academy and FDE residency 扩展了我们技术专家的工具包,帮助他们解决客户最棘手的问题。
blocks.en: “This collaboration between McKinsey and Anthropic is about leveraging frontier AI to create superior business outcomes for clients. Our technologists bring frontier AI expertise, sector depth and a value-creation mindset to our client work. The Residency sets the bar for how they apply Claude in service of our clients’ business goals, giving our world-class talent experience learning frontier techniques alongside Anthropic’s engineers. The Claude Frontier Academy and FDE Residency extend our technologists’ toolkit, helping them solve our clients’ toughest problems hands-on-keys.”

blocks.text: Senior Partner and Global Co-leader of QuantumBlack, McKinsey
blocks.zh: 高级合伙人兼 " 量子黑色 " 全球联合负责人,麦肯锡
blocks.en: Senior Partner and Global Co-leader of QuantumBlack, McKinsey

blocks.text: “AI is already changing how we discover and develop medicines at Novo. With Claude Science in our R&D workflows, Anthropic’s frontier models in our software development, lab in the loop research in drug discovery, and Anthropic engineers working alongside our scientists, we have seen what is possible when frontier AI meets deep scientific expertise. We’re excited to join the Claude Frontier Academy and the FDE Residency, giving our engineers the same hands on training and expertise behind Anthropic’s most successful deployments, so together we can bring the next generation of medicines to patients faster.”
blocks.zh: “大赦国际已经在改变我们在诺沃发现和发展药品的方式。随着Claude科学 在我们的研发工作流程,Anthropic在我们软件开发中的前沿模型,实验室在循环研究 药物发现,和人类的工程师 与我们的科学家合作,我们已经看到了当前沿AI遇到深厚的科学专长时可能发生的事情.我们很高兴加入克洛德边境学院 和FDE居住区,在安特罗皮克最成功的部署后 给我们的工程师提供同样的训练和专门知识因此,我们可以一起把下一代药物更快地带给病人。”
blocks.en: “AI is already changing how we discover and develop medicines at Novo. With Claude Science in our R&D workflows, Anthropic’s frontier models in our software development, lab in the loop research in drug discovery, and Anthropic engineers working alongside our scientists, we have seen what is possible when frontier AI meets deep scientific expertise. We’re excited to join the Claude Frontier Academy and the FDE Residency, giving our engineers the same hands on training and expertise behind Anthropic’s most successful deployments, so together we can bring the next generation of medicines to patients faster.”

blocks.text: VP Data & AI, Novo Nordisk
blocks.zh: VP 数据与AI,新北盘
blocks.en: VP Data & AI, Novo Nordisk

blocks.text: The Claude Partner Network
blocks.zh: Claude伙伴网络
blocks.en: The Claude Partner Network

blocks.text: Claude Frontier Academy builds on the Claude Partner Network, where professionals across 46,000 firms have earned more than 175,000 Claude certifications and nearly 4,000 people have completed Basecamp, an immersive program that teaches the same curriculum our Applied AI teams receive when they onboard. Claude Frontier Academy is for the people who will lead the work, and training 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers is the first step of many.
blocks.zh: Claude Frontier Academy 建立在Claude伙伴网络之上,共有46 000家公司的专业人员获得了超过175 000份Claude证书,将近4 000人完成了Basecamp,一个浸润方案 教授同样的课程 我们的应用AI团队 在他们上船时得到。Claude Frontier Academy是负责领导工作的人的培训10 000名边疆部署的工程师是许多人的第一步。
blocks.en: Claude Frontier Academy builds on the Claude Partner Network, where professionals across 46,000 firms have earned more than 175,000 Claude certifications and nearly 4,000 people have completed Basecamp, an immersive program that teaches the same curriculum our Applied AI teams receive when they onboard. Claude Frontier Academy is for the people who will lead the work, and training 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers is the first step of many.

translation: Argos Open Tech 1.9 / offline machine translation
